parameters.name: referenceImages
parameters.description: Reference images for style or content guidance (up to 14). Mutually exclusive with input video — use reference images or a video, not both.
parameters.array_note: Pass an array, even for a single value — a bare value is ignored.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: Optional input video for video to image generation (e.g. a thumbnail from a clip). Mutually exclusive with reference images. Max ~15 MB inline.

parameters.name: videoFps
parameters.description: Frame sampling rate for the input video in (0, 24] fps. Lower values sample fewer frames. Defaults to 1.0 fps when unset. Only applies when a video is provided.

parameters.name: aspectRatio
parameters.description: Aspect ratio for the generated image

parameters.name: useGoogleSearch
parameters.description: Use Google Search to find more information about the prompt

parameters.name: thinkingLevel
parameters.description: Thinking level for the generated image

next_step.instructions: Optional: prompt_spark rewrites a short or underspecified prompt into an on-model one — pass your draft or the user intent as prompt (model_id is required), then use its recommended_call.parameters as the model_run parameters, as-is or edited. Skip it when the user wants their exact prompt used verbatim.
